title: LFBD context-to-safe-hold exercise

stages.label: NORMAL CONTEXT
stages.detail: Real/cached LFBD context loaded; no response action available.

stages.label: DETECT
stages.detail: Synthetic low-RCS track appears outside the protected volume.

stages.label: ASSESS
stages.detail: RF and radar disagree; uncertainty envelope expands.

stages.label: CIVIL CONFLICT
stages.detail: Synthetic AFR762 conflict drives a safety interlock.

stages.label: DEGRADED SOURCES
stages.detail: EO/IR is weather-limited and one sensor becomes stale.

stages.label: BOUNDED AUTHORITY
stages.detail: Named human authority is recorded; no autonomous effect is created.

stages.label: SAFE HOLD
stages.detail: Core abort and correlated S1 training evidence are visible.

stages.label: AFTER ACTION
stages.detail: Export provenance, timeline, interlock reason and limitations.

counterfactuals.label: Radar stale
counterfactuals.result: confidence decreases and posture remains surveillance-only

counterfactuals.label: Authority expired
counterfactuals.result: execution is inhibited and re-authorization is required

counterfactuals.label: Runway state changes
counterfactuals.result: affected sector and predicted conflict are recomputed

safety_boundary: All authority, commands, effects and acknowledgements are simulated training artifacts. Public data is context only.
